newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says U.N. refugee aid not enough.
newsitem.headline: Iran says U.N. refugee aid not enough.

text.p: Iran said on Monday millions of dollars the United Nations had agreed to provide in relief aid for the tens of thousands of Iraqi Kurds it was sheltering was not enough, state-run Tehran radio reported.

It quoted an interior ministry statement as thanking the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) for 9.25 billion rials ($3.1 million) in aid. But it added that the sum was "only a portion of the amount used by Iran...and cannot cover the needs of 60,000 Iraqi Kurdish refugees".

The UNHCR said last week it had alloted $3.6 million from its emergency fund to provide shelter, food and medicine for around 40,000 refugees its teams had visited in Iranian refugee camps. The cause for the discrepancy between the two figures was not clear.
The Iranian news agency IRNA said on Sunday Iran had already spent 25 billion rials ($8.3 million) on the Kurdish refugees fleeing recent fighting in northern Iraq.
Iran, already playing host to two million refugees from Afghanistan and Iraq, has repeatedly complained about what it said was the failure of world bodies to send relief for the new wave of refugees.
($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
